title: Study Tour
subtitle: 「學習旅行／考察團／學術參訪」，究竟是哪一種 study tour？
description: 「學習旅行／考察團／學術參訪」，究竟是哪一種 study tour？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，表示以學習、觀察或課程延伸為目的的旅行；比一般 trip 更明確帶有教育目的。
words.example: The school organised an educational trip to the science museum.
words.exampleZh: 學校安排了一次前往科學博物館的教育旅行。

exercises.original: The school organised a study tour to the science centre and museum.
exercises.zh: 學校安排了一次前往科學中心和博物館的教育旅行。
exercises.upgrade: educational trip · 教育旅行；學習之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 活動由學校安排且有明確學習地點，不是度假。
sightseeing tour = 雖然會參觀景點，但核心是教育目的。
educational trip = 學校安排、目的地為教育場所，最自然可概括為 educational trip。
business trip = 學生不是因公出差。
shopping trip = 完全不合。
leisure excursion = 會削弱學習目的。

exercises.original: Students went on a study tour as part of their environmental science course.
exercises.zh: 學生作為環境科學課程的一部分參加教育旅行。
exercises.upgrade: educational trip · 教育旅行；學習之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 和 as part of their course 矛盾。
sightseeing tour = 課程目的比觀光更重要。
business trip = 不合學生語境。
educational trip = as part of their course 明確支持 educational trip。
day off = 不是休假。
social outing = 不是以社交為主。

exercises.original: The study tour gave pupils a chance to learn outside the classroom.
exercises.zh: 這次學習旅行讓學生有機會在課室外學習。
exercises.upgrade: educational trip · 教育旅行；學習之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 不是休閒假期。
sightseeing tour = 原句直接說 learn outside the classroom。
shopping trip = 不合。
business trip = 不合。
educational trip = learn outside the classroom 是 educational trip 的直接線索。
recreational outing = 不是娛樂為主。

words.meaning: 學習考察；學習性短途旅行
words.note: 強調透過實地參觀、觀察和體驗來學習，通常時間較短、目的地較集中；比 study tour 更像單次外出考察。
words.example: Students joined a learning excursion to the wetlands.
words.exampleZh: 學生參加了一次前往濕地的學習考察。

exercises.original: The class took a study tour to the wetlands to observe bird habitats.
exercises.zh: 全班到濕地進行學習考察，觀察鳥類棲息地。
exercises.upgrade: learning excursion · 學習考察；學習性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 不是休假。
sightseeing tour = 觀察棲息地是學習活動，不是單純看景。
business trip = 不合。
learning excursion = 短途到實地觀察並學習，learning excursion 很自然。
shopping excursion = 不合。
social outing = 不合。

exercises.original: The study tour involved visiting a recycling plant for hands-on learning.
exercises.zh: 這次學習考察包括參觀回收廠作實地學習。
exercises.upgrade: learning excursion · 學習考察；學習性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 和 hands-on learning 不符。
sightseeing trip = 工業設施參訪是學習目的。
business trip = 學生不是工作出差。
leisure outing = 不合。
learning excursion = hands-on learning 強調實地學習，因此 learning excursion 最精確。
shopping trip = 不合。

exercises.original: Teachers planned a short study tour to the local nature reserve.
exercises.zh: 老師安排了一次短途到本地自然保護區的學習考察。
exercises.upgrade: learning excursion · 學習考察；學習性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 不是休閒活動。
field holiday = 不自然。
business visit = 不合。
sightseeing excursion = 沒有娛樂觀光重點。
shopping outing = 不合。
learning excursion = short + educational destination 很適合 learning excursion。

words.note: 較正式，常指學生、教師或研究人員到大學、研究機構、企業或其他專業場所進行學習交流。
words.example: The department arranged an academic visit to a partner university.
words.exampleZh: 學系安排了一次到合作大學的學術訪問。

exercises.original: The university arranged a study tour to a partner research institute.
exercises.zh: 大學安排了一次到合作研究所的學術訪問。
exercises.upgrade: academic visit · 學術訪問；學術參訪

options.explanation: holiday = 研究所參訪不是度假。
sightseeing tour = 不是一般觀光。
shopping trip = 不合。
business trip = 雖可能有工作元素，但原句核心是 university learning。
academic visit = 大學到研究機構進行正式學習交流，academic visit 最精確。
social call = 過於私人。

exercises.original: Postgraduate students joined a study tour at another university's laboratory.
exercises.zh: 研究生到另一所大學的實驗室參加學術訪問。
exercises.upgrade: academic visit · 學術訪問；學術參訪

options.explanation: holiday = 不合研究生學習目的。
tourist visit = 不合 laboratory context。
business trip = 不是商務。
school outing = 語體過於基礎。
shopping trip = 不合。
academic visit = postgraduate students + university laboratory 是典型 academic-visit 語境。

exercises.original: The study tour included meetings with faculty members and researchers.
exercises.zh: 這次學術訪問包括與教員和研究人員會面。
exercises.upgrade: academic visit · 學術訪問；學術參訪

options.explanation: academic visit = 與 academics 正式交流學習，最自然是 academic visit。
sightseeing tour = 會面 faculty/researchers 明顯超出觀光。
holiday = 不合。
leisure excursion = 不合。
business conference = 不是正式會議活動本身。
shopping trip = 不合。

words.note: 非常常見，指學生離開課室，到實際地點進行觀察、研究或學習；可是一日活動，也可較短。
words.example: The geography class went on a field trip to the coast.
words.exampleZh: 地理班到海岸進行實地考察。

exercises.original: The geography students went on a study tour to examine coastal erosion.
exercises.zh: 地理學生到海岸進行實地考察，研究海岸侵蝕。
exercises.upgrade: field trip · 實地考察；校外教學

options.explanation: holiday = 不是休閒旅行。
sightseeing tour = examining erosion 是課程研究。
business trip = 不合。
exchange visit = 沒有與另一群體交流。
shopping excursion = 不合。
field trip = 課程直接到現場觀察自然現象，標準說法是 field trip。

exercises.original: The biology class took a study tour to collect water samples.
exercises.zh: 生物班進行實地考察以收集水樣。
exercises.upgrade: field trip · 實地考察；校外教學

options.explanation: field trip = 到現場採樣是典型 fieldwork，因此 field trip 最自然。
holiday = 和 sample collection 不符。
sightseeing trip = 不是看風景。
academic conference = 不是會議。
business visit = 不合。
social outing = 不合。

exercises.original: The students' study tour lasted one afternoon and focused on local geology.
exercises.zh: 學生的實地考察只用了一個下午，重點研究本地地質。
exercises.upgrade: field trip · 實地考察；校外教學

options.explanation: study abroad = 時間和規模完全不符。
field trip = 短時間、單一學術主題的校外學習活動最典型是 field trip。
holiday = 不合。
exchange visit = 沒有交流對象。
business trip = 不合。
sightseeing tour = local geology 是課程內容。

words.note: 常見於教育、政府、專業培訓和國際交流，表示到某機構或地方參觀並學習其做法。
words.example: The delegation made a study visit to several vocational colleges.
words.exampleZh: 代表團到數間職業學院進行學習訪問。

exercises.original: The delegation went on a study tour to observe vocational training systems.
exercises.zh: 代表團進行學習訪問，以了解職業培訓制度。
exercises.upgrade: study visit · 學習訪問；考察訪問

options.explanation: study visit = 代表團觀摩制度與做法，study visit 是常見正式用語。
holiday = 代表團目的不是休閒。
sightseeing tour = observe systems 是專業學習。
shopping trip = 不合。
social visit = 不是純社交。
vacation = 不合。

exercises.original: Officials joined a study tour to learn how another city manages waste.
exercises.zh: 官員參加學習訪問，了解另一城市如何管理廢物。
exercises.upgrade: study visit · 學習訪問；考察訪問

options.explanation: business trip = 雖有公務成分，但核心是觀摩學習。
study visit = 政策／政府人員到他處學習做法，study visit 很精確。
holiday = 不合。
tourist visit = 不合。
shopping trip = 不合。
leisure excursion = 不合。

exercises.original: The training programme includes a study tour to several successful community projects.
exercises.zh: 培訓計劃包括到數個成功社區項目進行學習訪問。
exercises.upgrade: study visit · 學習訪問；考察訪問

options.explanation: holiday = 和 training programme 不符。
sightseeing tour = 不是景點觀光。
study visit = 專業培訓中到其他項目觀摩，study visit 很自然。
business trip = 不夠突出學習目的。
shopping excursion = 不合。
social outing = 不合。

words.meaning: 教育考察；教育性短途旅行
words.note: 和 learning excursion 接近，表示以教學和學習為目的的短途外出活動；較正式。
words.example: The museum offers educational excursions for secondary-school students.
words.exampleZh: 博物館為中學生提供教育考察活動。

exercises.original: The museum organised a study tour for primary-school pupils.
exercises.zh: 博物館為小學生安排了一次教育考察。
exercises.upgrade: educational excursion · 教育考察；教育性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 不合 museum education context。
educational excursion = 兒童到教育場所進行短途活動，educational excursion 很自然。
business trip = 不合兒童。
shopping trip = 不合。
sightseeing holiday = 過於休閒。
social event = 不合。

exercises.original: The study tour was designed to support classroom learning.
exercises.zh: 這次教育考察旨在支援課堂學習。
exercises.upgrade: educational excursion · 教育考察；教育性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 和 classroom learning 相反。
business trip = 不合。
educational excursion = support classroom learning 直接定義 educational excursion。
leisure outing = 不合。
shopping visit = 不合。
sightseeing tour = 學習目的更明確。

exercises.original: The school planned a one-day study tour to a heritage site.
exercises.zh: 學校安排了一次一日制前往文化遺址的教育考察。
exercises.upgrade: educational excursion · 教育考察；教育性短途旅行

options.explanation: holiday = 一日學校活動不是度假。
academic conference = 不是會議。
business trip = 不合。
educational excursion = one-day + school + heritage site 很適合 educational excursion。
shopping trip = 不合。
tourist holiday = 過於休閒。

words.note: 和 study tour 非常接近，但通常規模可大可小，不一定包含多站行程；教育機構和培訓語境常用。
words.example: The students took a study trip to several historical sites.
words.exampleZh: 學生進行了一次到多個歷史遺址的學習旅行。

exercises.original: Students took a study tour to several historical sites over three days.
exercises.zh: 學生用了三天到數個歷史遺址進行學習旅行。
exercises.upgrade: study trip · 學習旅行；考察之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 不是純休閒。
field trip = 通常更短、更集中於單一課程現場；三天多站較像 study trip。
study trip = 多日、多站但仍以學習為目的，可自然稱 study trip。
business trip = 不合。
shopping tour = 不合。
social outing = 不合。

exercises.original: The course includes a study tour during the spring term.
exercises.zh: 課程在春季學期包括一次學習旅行。
exercises.upgrade: study trip · 學習旅行；考察之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 因為屬 course component，不是度假。
business trip = 不合。
tourist trip = 不夠突出學習目的。
study trip = 作為課程正式組成部分，study trip 很自然。
shopping excursion = 不合。
social visit = 不合。

exercises.original: The students prepared reports after returning from the study tour.
exercises.zh: 學生從學習旅行回來後撰寫報告。
exercises.upgrade: study trip · 學習旅行；考察之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 旅程後需提交 reports，明顯是學習活動。
sightseeing tour = 不夠精確。
business trip = 不合學生。
shopping trip = 不合。
study trip = 旅後有學習成果／報告，study trip 很貼切。
leisure excursion = 不合。

words.note: 當重點是到某一具體機構或地點參觀學習時自然；比 trip 更聚焦 visit 本身。
words.example: The class made an educational visit to the local courthouse.
words.exampleZh: 全班到本地法院進行教育參訪。

exercises.original: The class made a study tour to the local courthouse.
exercises.zh: 全班到本地法院進行教育參訪。
exercises.upgrade: educational visit · 教育參訪；學習參觀

options.explanation: holiday = 法院不是休閒目的地。
sightseeing tour = 重點是學習司法運作。
business trip = 學生不是工作出差。
educational visit = 單一具體機構的學習參觀，educational visit 最自然。
shopping visit = 不合。
social call = 不合。

exercises.original: Pupils went on a study tour to a fire station to learn about emergency services.
exercises.zh: 學生到消防局參訪，了解緊急服務。
exercises.upgrade: educational visit · 教育參訪；學習參觀

options.explanation: holiday = 不合。
tourist visit = 消防局不是一般景點。
business trip = 不合。
shopping trip = 不合。
educational visit = to learn about emergency services 明確是教育參訪。
social event = 不合。

exercises.original: The programme includes a study tour to a newspaper office.
exercises.zh: 計劃包括一次到報館的教育參訪。
exercises.upgrade: educational visit · 教育參訪；學習參觀

options.explanation: business trip = 參加者不是為工作談生意。
holiday = 不合。
sightseeing tour = 不只是看看。
shopping excursion = 不合。
leisure outing = 不合。
educational visit = 到一個具體 workplace 了解其運作，educational visit 很精確。

words.note: 較正式、較書面，指和課程、研究或學術訓練直接相關的外出考察；日常頻率低於 field trip。
words.example: The course includes an academic excursion to an archaeological site.
words.exampleZh: 課程包括一次前往考古遺址的學術考察。

exercises.original: The archaeology course includes a study tour to a Roman site.
exercises.zh: 考古學課程包括一次到羅馬遺址的學術考察。
exercises.upgrade: academic excursion · 學術考察；學術性外出

options.explanation: holiday = 不合 course context。
sightseeing tour = 雖是古蹟，但課程目的是 academic study。
business trip = 不合。
shopping tour = 不合。
academic excursion = 課程直接相關的學術性外出，可正式稱 academic excursion。
social outing = 不合。

exercises.original: Researchers joined a study tour to inspect several historical archives.
exercises.zh: 研究人員參加學術考察，檢視數個歷史檔案館。
exercises.upgrade: academic excursion · 學術考察；學術性外出

options.explanation: holiday = 研究目的明確。
tourist visit = 不是休閒參觀。
business trip = 沒有商務目的。
shopping excursion = 不合。
social call = 不合。
academic excursion = researchers + inspect archives 明確是學術考察。

exercises.original: The seminar was followed by a study tour to a nearby excavation site.
exercises.zh: 研討會後安排了一次到附近發掘場的學術考察。
exercises.upgrade: academic excursion · 學術考察；學術性外出

options.explanation: academic excursion = seminar + excavation site 形成非常典型的 academic-excursion 語境。
holiday = 與 seminar academic context 不符。
sightseeing tour = excavation site 是研究現場。
business trip = 不合。
shopping trip = 不合。
social outing = 不合。

words.meaning: 考察訪問；實地了解之旅
words.note: 當 study tour 的目的是了解實際運作、蒐集資訊或比較制度時適用；常見於政策、專業和代表團語境。
words.example: Officials made a fact-finding visit to several transport projects.
words.exampleZh: 官員到數個交通項目進行實地考察。

exercises.original: Officials went on a study tour to understand how the new transport system works.
exercises.zh: 官員進行實地考察，以了解新交通系統如何運作。
exercises.upgrade: fact-finding visit · 考察訪問；實地了解之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 官員不是休閒旅遊。
sightseeing tour = 重點是了解制度運作。
business trip = 過於泛，未突出蒐集資訊。
social visit = 不合。
shopping trip = 不合。
fact-finding visit = to understand how ... works 明確是蒐集資訊／考察，fact-finding visit 最精確。

exercises.original: The committee organised a study tour before deciding whether to fund the project.
exercises.zh: 委員會在決定是否資助項目前安排了考察訪問。
exercises.upgrade: fact-finding visit · 考察訪問；實地了解之旅

options.explanation: fact-finding visit = 在作決策前到現場了解事實，最自然是 fact-finding visit。
holiday = 不合決策語境。
sightseeing tour = 不是看景點。
exchange visit = 沒有雙向交流重點。
business trip = 不夠突出調查目的。
social outing = 不合。

exercises.original: The delegation's study tour focused on gathering information about housing policy.
exercises.zh: 代表團的考察訪問重點是蒐集住屋政策資料。
exercises.upgrade: fact-finding visit · 考察訪問；實地了解之旅

options.explanation: holiday = 和 gathering information 不符。
fact-finding visit = gathering information 是 fact-finding 的直接線索。
tourist trip = 不合。
shopping visit = 不合。
social call = 不合。
business conference = 不是會議本身。

words.note: 當 study tour 包含與另一所學校、機構或團體交流、觀摩和互動時可用；比一般 educational trip 更強調雙向交流。
words.example: The students took part in an exchange visit with a school overseas.
words.exampleZh: 學生參加了與海外學校的交流訪問。

exercises.original: Students went on a study tour to meet pupils at a partner school overseas.
exercises.zh: 學生進行交流訪問，到海外合作學校與當地學生見面。
exercises.upgrade: exchange visit · 交流訪問

options.explanation: exchange visit = partner school + meet pupils 明確是 exchange visit。
holiday = 不是純休閒。
sightseeing tour = 核心是和 partner school 互動。
business trip = 不合。
field trip = 沒有實地研究主題。
shopping excursion = 不合。

exercises.original: The study tour involved joint workshops with students from another college.
exercises.zh: 這次交流訪問包括與另一所學院學生一起進行工作坊。
exercises.upgrade: exchange visit · 交流訪問

options.explanation: holiday = joint workshops 明顯是學習交流。
exchange visit = joint workshops + another college 是典型 exchange-visit 語境。
sightseeing tour = 不是觀光。
business trip = 不合學生。
field trip = 沒有 fieldwork 內容。
social outing = 工作坊令目的更正式。

exercises.original: The school hopes the study tour will build links with its overseas partner.
exercises.zh: 學校希望交流訪問能加強與海外伙伴的聯繫。
exercises.upgrade: exchange visit · 交流訪問

options.explanation: holiday = 不是為休閒。
tourist visit = 不合 institutional partnership。
exchange visit = build links with its overseas partner 最直接支持 exchange visit。
business trip = 學校交流不等於商務。
field trip = 沒有 field study。
shopping tour = 不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 度假不等於學習考察 holiday 主要目的是休息、娛樂或旅遊；study tour 的核心是學習、觀察或學術活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A holiday is for leisure; a study tour is organised for learning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀光團不等於考察團 sightseeing tour 主要為看景點和旅遊；study tour 需要明確教育或專業學習目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sightseeing focuses on attractions; a study tour focuses on learning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 實地考察只在部分語境等同 study tour field trip 常是一日或短時間、與課程直接相關；study tour 往往可跨多日、多站或包含交流活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A field trip is often shorter and more focused than a study tour.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學術訪問通常更聚焦單一機構 academic visit 常指到大學、研究機構等進行正式學習交流；study tour 可以包含多種教育場所。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An academic visit may be one stop within a wider study tour.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公幹不等於學習旅行 business trip 主要目的是工作、會議或商務；除非重點真是觀摩學習，否則不能等同 study tour。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A business trip is for work; a study tour is primarily educational.

falseSynonyms.zh: 短途旅行不一定有學習目的 excursion 只表示短途外出；需有 educational / learning 等修飾才接近 study tour。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An excursion may be recreational unless its learning purpose is stated.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學校旅行範圍更廣 school trip 可以是教育、社交或娛樂活動；study tour 明確以學習為核心。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A school trip may be recreational, while a study tour has a learning objective.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單字分開不等於 study tour study 是學習；tour 是旅行／巡遊。兩字組成固定概念後才表示學習考察之旅。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A tour is not automatically a study tour unless learning is its purpose.
